papers.title: Micellar LYTAC-engineered bionic coatings abrogate RANK-dependent osteocatabolism and boost fibrillogenesis-mimetic mineral accretion for empowering osteoporotic osseointegration.
papers.abstract: Patients with osteoporosis are highly susceptible to fractures that often require implant fixation and stabilization. However, excessive osteoclast activity under osteoporotic conditions accelerates bone resorption at the bone-implant interface, severely compromising implant osseointegration. RANKL-RANK axis is a central regulator of osteoclast function and emerges as a promising target for osteoporosis treatment, yet current therapeutic options primarily rely on reversible ligand neutralization and can be followed by rebound bone loss after treatment discontinuation. Here, we developed a biomimetic titanium implant coating incorporating RANK-targeted micellar lysosome-targeting chimeras (LYTACs) to enhance osseointegration under osteoporotic conditions. Collagen-like peptides (CLPs) were conjugated to bispecific aptamers targeting RANK and the cation-independent mannose-6-phosphate receptor (CI-M6PR) through acid-responsive linkers. The resulting conjugates self-assembled into supramolecular LYTACs (CLP-Apt) and were integrated onto hydroxyapatite-modified titanium surfaces. Hydroxyapatite facilitated mesenchymal stem cell (MSC) recruitment, whereas acidic microenvironmental cues triggered CLP-Apt release. Simultaneous engagement of RANK and CI-M6PR on osteoclasts directed RANK toward lysosomal degradation, thereby suppressing osteoclast-mediated bone resorption while promoting MSC osteogenic differentiation and type H vessel formation. Following lysosomal processing, the released CLPs assembled extracellularly into bone matrix-mimetic fibers that chelated Ca2+ and accelerated new bone formation through a fibrillogenesis-mimetic process. By directly degrading RANK while promoting vascularized bone regeneration, this coating provides a localized strategy to overcome osteoclast-driven implant failure and achieve rapid, robust osseointegration under osteoporotic conditions.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦骨质疏松条件下钛植入物涂层的分子生物学机制，与股骨柄应力遮挡、微动或界面力学无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify femoral stem stress shielding, micromotion, primary stability, or bone-implant contact mechanics; it is a molecular biology and surface chemistry study with no FEA or mechanical validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 骨质疏松患者植入物界面骨吸收过快，现有治疗易反弹，需局部干预策略。
summary_zh.method: 构建RANK靶向胶束LYTAC涂层，通过酸响应释放降解RANK并促矿化。
summary_zh.result: 涂层抑制破骨吸收、促进MSC成骨与H型血管形成，增强骨质疏松骨整合。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验与分子机制验证，未涉及力学或有限元分析。

summary_en.motivation: Osteoporotic patients suffer rapid peri-implant bone resorption, and current systemic therapies risk rebound bone loss after discontinuation.
summary_en.method: A biomimetic titanium coating with RANK-targeted micellar LYTACs was engineered to degrade RANK via lysosomal targeting while releasing collagen-like peptides for mineralization.
summary_en.result: The coating suppressed osteoclast-mediated resorption and promoted MSC osteogenesis and type H vessel formation, enhancing osteoporotic osseointegration.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell and molecular assays were used, with no mechanical testing or finite element analysis.
